notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hey there !

Today I rolled out a new Chromatic update after all this time.
It's mostly constituted of balance changes to make make the game more even for the player and to address some problems.

[h1] Balance changes[/h1]
[list]
   [*] Buffed Healer HP by 10%
   [*] Buffed Healer recover by 10%
   [*] Buffed enemy's regular plasma projectile damage by 16%
   [*] Tweaked final boss Offensive phase to make it more fair
   [*] Increased signficantly points for destroying final boss crystals (offensive and defensive)
   [*] Nerfed final boss HP by 16%
   [*] Buffed player laser dps from 465 to 480
   [*] Slightly more Health packs will appear
[/list]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
   [*] Splash screen overhaul !
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
   [*] Fixed and optimized comet VFX (less lag)
   [*] Fixed a bug where all Security devices (laser) would go off-screen (oops !)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.01 live !
notes.content:
A very small patch fixing some little bugs.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
   [*] Fixed various UI bugs related to Co-op mode with 2 controllers.
   [*] Fixed a bug where 2nd player's controller buttons were incorrectly binded.
[/list]

Thats all for now !
